analysis:
Examined both BASE documentation excerpts in docs/provider/cli-reference.md:805–1726 and the complete change orientation. The sole addition (HEAD line 1960 in the supplied patch) documents DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_SSD_INCREMENTAL_CHECKPOINTS and its complete-checkpoint rollback; neither supplied BASE excerpt is changed. Surrounding documentation distinguishes consent from activation, fresh serving authorization from self-route eligibility, remote revocation from local logout, private diagnostic details from fixed public logs, and uncached serving from cache initialization failure. No concrete regression is established by this documentation-only evidence.
The new delta-checkpoint option concerns A-001, TB-007 and T-041, but implementation is not supplied here. Integration should examine provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/KVCacheSSD/SSDPrefixCachePolicy.swift and delta write/restore consumers: preserve authenticated account/model/layout bindings, HMAC-only disk identities, AES-GCM authentication, bounded staging and dependency lifetimes, 30-minute reuse limits, and safe recomputation when ancestors expire or are corrupt. Confirm incremental storage does not broaden donations or retain usable expired prefixes. This is an unresolved implementation contract, not evidence of a missing control. Only selected canonical definitions were supplied in full; the excerpts do not establish runtime behavior or deployment qualification.
